title: Path Sum: A Hike of Exactly 13 Kilometers
summary: Carry the distance so far down each fork; a campsite at exactly the target ends the search early.

analogy.scenario: A trail map starts at a trailhead and forks into legs that end at campsites. A hiker wants a route from the trailhead to a campsite that is exactly 13 km long.

mapping.real: A waypoint and the length of its leg
Forks still waiting to hear back
Calling the search off once a route works

takeaway.summary: Pass the running sum down to each child. At a leaf, compare it with the target. Return left || right, so the first true stops the search.
whenToUse: Root-to-leaf questions where each path carries a running value
Searches that can stop as soon as one path works

scenes.narration: A trail map forks from the trailhead down to campsites, and each number is the length of a leg. Is there a route to a campsite that is exactly 13 kilometers?
scenes.caption: Find a route from the trailhead to a campsite: exactly 13 km

scenes.narration: You could list every route and add each one up from the start, but routes share their first legs, so you'd keep re-adding the same kilometers.
scenes.caption: Adding up every route from scratch repeats the shared legs

scenes.narration: Instead, carry the running total as you walk. The trailhead leg is 6 kilometers. Only a campsite can end a route, so keep going down.
scenes.caption: Carry the kilometers so far down each fork

scenes.narration: Down the left fork, 3 more makes 9, and campsite 1 makes 10. It's a campsite, but 10 isn't 13, so this route answers false.
scenes.caption: Campsite 1: 6 + 3 + 1 = 10 km, not 13

scenes.narration: Back at waypoint 3, try its other fork. Campsite 4 brings the total to exactly 13. This campsite answers true.
scenes.caption: Campsite 4: 6 + 3 + 4 = 13 km exactly

scenes.narration: True travels back up, and the trailhead stops right there. The legs to 9 and 2 are never walked: the first route that works is enough.
scenes.caption: One route works: the right side is never walked

scenes.narration: Waypoints are nodes, campsites are leaves, and the running total is a value passed down each call. Returning left or right stops at the first true. That's O(n) time and O(h) space.
scenes.caption: Waypoints are nodes; campsites are leaves
